candidates.name: 01N11 / 120–1S35 Connect — east-side forest-road scouting corridor

geometryEvidence.coordinateSource: Actual source road vertex, not an invented campsite

candidates.carEvidence: Current MVUM explicitly lists passenger vehicles open yearlong, but also maintenance level 2/high-clearance. Inyo guidance supports dispersed camping outside restricted areas and requires staying on established roads; it does not identify this vertex as a sleeping/parking space.
rules: County no-dispersed-camping, LADWP and wilderness layers returned no hit at this precise road vertex.
Do not drive off-road to camp; use an existing cleared durable surface at least 200 feet from water.
14 consecutive days at one location/10-mile radius; 28 days per calendar year forest-wide under Order 05-04-50-25-17.
A source road vertex is a corridor reference, not an approved pullout. Ordinary-car suitability is not established by legal MVUM access.

geometryEvidence.coordinateSource: Official Caltrans point geometry; current KML has rounded coordinates

Directional highway access: westbound I-80. Do not cross the median or enter against traffic.
Open facility status does not mean an unoccupied parking space is guaranteed.
